description: This PHP source file defines the class VTCreateEventTask which extends VTTask. The class is responsible for creating calendar events within the vtiger CRM system, including handling recurrence patterns and event properties. It includes methods for fetching user context, processing task data, and calculating event dates.

classes.name: VTCreateEventTask
classes.description: A class responsible for creating calendar events in vtiger CRM, supporting recurring events, and managing event properties based on task data.

methods.name: getFieldNames
methods.description: Returns an array of field names used for event creation, including date, time, recurrence, and other event properties.

methods.name: getAdmin
methods.description: Retrieves the active administrative user for system operations.

methods.name: doTask
methods.description: Executes the task of creating and possibly recurring calendar events based on provided entity data.

methods.name: calculateDate
methods.description: Calculates a date offset by a specified number of days before or after a base date.

methods.name: conv12to24hour
methods.description: Converts a 12-hour time string with am/pm to a 24-hour format.

methods.name: getTimeFieldList
methods.description: Returns a list of time fields relevant for this task.
